restoredFrom.description: The revision this change restored; null for an ordinary change.

changedBy.description: Who made the change: `user:<id>` or `client:<id>`; `anonymized` once their account was deleted; `unknown` for the state a record had before revisions were kept.

changedByName.description: The name of who made the change, as every member of the tenant sees it (GET /v1/people); null for `anonymized`, `unknown`, or anyone the tenant never had.

changes.description: The fields that differ, from `a`’s value to `b`’s (`custom.<key>` per custom value).

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; null: no more (and with `page`).

nextPage.description: With `page`: the next page; null: no more.

total.description: With `count=true`: the rows matching the filters, all pages; the cap when totalCapped.

template.description: The template it was issued from: an `id` of `documentTemplates` in GET /v1/lists/{subject}.

language.description: The language it is written in (`?lang=` of the request).

key.description: Who asked for it: `user:<id>`, `client:<id>`, or `anonymized`.

name.description: Their name (a member or former member, an API client of the tenant); null when there is none (`anonymized`, a removed client).

finishedAt.description: When it was issued (`completed`) or failed; null while queued or rendering.

attachmentId.description: Once completed: the PDF, an attachment of the record (GET /v1/attachments/{id}/download, `?inline=true` to show it).

error.description: Why it failed, written for people.

data.description: What the texts were made from, and what a client needs to act on it.

link.description: A path of the web app, or null.

key.description: The collapse key, when it has one.

count.description: How many notifications this one stands for (collapsed).

notification.description: A new notification, in the recipient's language.

notification.read.description: A notification was marked read (or unread: `readAt` null).

notifications.read-all.description: `before`: what the call passed (null: all of them); `updated`: how many changed.

notifications.unread-count.description: After each of the above and each delivery: the badge's number.

data.export-ready.description: An export is ready: `url` is a signed link to the file.

data.import-finished.description: An import ended: how many rows were imported and how many refused.

data.progress.description: An export or import is running: `processed` rows so far (an import also `imported` and `failed`). Throttled (an export: at most once a second; an import: every 500 rows); `GET /v1/data/transfers/{id}` has the same numbers.

data.failed.description: An export or import failed for good (not a few refused rows: that is `data.import-finished`); `error` says why, for people. The transfer reads `failed` at `GET /v1/data/transfers/{id}` by now.

approval.assigned.description: An approval request waits for you (or for someone you stand in for): `GET /v1/approvals/{id}`.

approval.decided.description: A decision on a request you made or decide, or its end: `status` is the request's after it (pending while stages remain); `decision` null when no person decided (cancelled, expired, failed).

approval.applied.description: An approved request's outcome was applied (the note is published, say): `outcomeAppliedAt` is now set on `GET /v1/approvals/{id}`. To the requester and the approvers of the round, once; a banner showing "approved, applying" can clear without polling.

bulk.finished.description: A queued bulk operation ended; its item results: `GET /v1/bulk/{id}`.

bulk.progress.description: A queued bulk run is running: items processed so far, every few hundred items.

bulk.failed.description: A queued bulk run failed for good (its worker was lost, say); items done stay done (`GET /v1/bulk/{id}`, the audit log). `error` says why, for people.

document.ready.description: A document you asked for (`POST /v1/notes/{id}/pdf`) was issued: the PDF is the record's attachment `attachmentId`.

document.failed.description: A document you asked for failed for good; `error` says why, for people.

ai.ready.description: An AI run you asked for (`POST /v1/ai/runs`) finished: read the answer at `GET /v1/ai/runs/{id}`.

ai.failed.description: An AI run you asked for failed for good; `error` says why, for people.

record.commented.description: A comment on a record you watch (or one you wrote, for your other tabs) was added, edited or removed: ids only, fetch the thread.

record.attachments.changed.description: A file on a record you watch was uploaded, removed, issued (a PDF) or scanned clean (it can be downloaded now; MALWARE_SCANNER): ids only.
